# R package streamMOA - Interface for MOA Stream Clustering Algorithms

[![Package on
CRAN](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/streamMOA)](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=streamMOA)
[![CRAN RStudio mirror
downloads](https://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/streamMOA)](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=streamMOA)
![License](https://img.shields.io/cran/l/streamMOA)[![r-universe
status](https://mhahsler.r-universe.dev/badges/streamMOA)](https://mhahsler.r-universe.dev/streamMOA)

**Maintainer:** [Michael Hahsler](https://michael.hahsler.net)

Interface for data stream clustering algorithms implemented in the MOA
(Massive Online Analysis) framework. This is an extension package for
[stream](https://michael.hahsler.net/stream/).

## Installation

**Stable CRAN version:** Install from within R with

``` r

install.packages("streamMOA")
```

**Current development version:** Install from
[r-universe.](https://mhahsler.r-universe.dev/streamMOA)

``` r

install.packages("streamMOA",
    repos = c("https://mhahsler.r-universe.dev",
              "https://cloud.r-project.org/"))
```

## Example

Create 3 clusters with 5% noise.

``` r

library(streamMOA)

stream <- DSD_Gaussians(k = 3, d = 2, noise = 0.05)
```

Cluster with CluStream.

``` r

clustream <- DSC_CluStream(m = 50, k = 3)
update(clustream, stream, 500)
clustream
```

``` R
## CluStream 
## Class: moa/clusterers/clustream/WithKmeans, DSC_MOA, DSC_Micro, DSC 
## Number of micro-clusters: 50 
## Number of macro-clusters: 3
```

Plot micro-clusters.

``` r

plot(clustream, stream)
```

![](reference/figures/README-plot-1.png)

# Package index

## Online clustering

MOA-based stream clustering algorithms and their shared interface.

- [`DSC_MOA()`](http://michael.hahsler.net/streamMOA/reference/DSC_MOA.md)
  : DSC_MOA Class
- [`DSC_BICO_MOA()`](http://michael.hahsler.net/streamMOA/reference/DSC_BICO_MOA.md)
  : BICO: Fast computation of k-means coresets in a data stream
- [`DSC_CluStream()`](http://michael.hahsler.net/streamMOA/reference/DSC_CluStream.md)
  : CluStream Data Stream Clusterer
- [`DSC_ClusTree()`](http://michael.hahsler.net/streamMOA/reference/DSC_ClusTree.md)
  : ClusTree Data Stream Clusterer
- [`DSC_DStream_MOA()`](http://michael.hahsler.net/streamMOA/reference/DSC_DStream_MOA.md)
  : D-Stream Data Stream Clustering Algorithm
- [`DSC_DenStream()`](http://michael.hahsler.net/streamMOA/reference/DSC_DenStream.md)
  : DenStream Data Stream Clusterer
- [`DSC_StreamKM()`](http://michael.hahsler.net/streamMOA/reference/DSC_StreamKM.md)
  : streamKM++

## Stream generators

Generate streams using MOA.

- [`DSD_MOA()`](http://michael.hahsler.net/streamMOA/reference/DSD_MOA.md)
  : Base class for MOA-based data stream generators
- [`DSD_RandomRBFGeneratorEvents()`](http://michael.hahsler.net/streamMOA/reference/DSD_RandomRBFGeneratorEvents.md)
  : Random RBF Generator Events Data Stream Generator

## Outlier detection

MCOD clustering and outlier management.

- [`DSC_MCOD()`](http://michael.hahsler.net/streamMOA/reference/DSC_MCOD.md)
  [`DSOutlier_MCOD()`](http://michael.hahsler.net/streamMOA/reference/DSC_MCOD.md)
  [`get_outlier_positions()`](http://michael.hahsler.net/streamMOA/reference/DSC_MCOD.md)
  [`recheck_outlier()`](http://michael.hahsler.net/streamMOA/reference/DSC_MCOD.md)
  [`clean_outliers()`](http://michael.hahsler.net/streamMOA/reference/DSC_MCOD.md)
  : Micro-cluster Continuous Outlier Detector (MCOD)
